prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D platformer enemy sprite poses. Original cute SNEEZING CLOUD SHEEP for a bright fantasy Cloud Kingdom with cream cloud bridges, blue sky and golden sky palaces. A compact fluffy white cloud-shaped sheep, pale sky-blue face, rosy little nose, soft lavender shading in cloud wool, tiny curling gold horns and golden hooves, a short mint scarf attached around neck. Expressive cheeky gentle enemy, round friendly silhouette, strong teal-plum outlines readable on pale sky. Hand-painted storybook gouache texture with cream, sky blue, lavender, mint and gold. Full body RIGHT facing three-quarter profile, feet visible. EXACTLY EIGHT complete poses of SAME character on a FOUR columns by TWO rows grid. Every sheep occupies only SIXTY-FIVE percent of its equal cell, with wide transparent gutters, no part touching cell or image boundaries, same body scale. Reading order: 1 idle smile, 2 idle blink, 3 walking A, 4 walking B, 5 warning inhales deeply with puffed cheeks and head drawn back, 6 attack sneeze leaning forward eyes squeezed closed and mouth open, WITHOUT any detached air clouds or projectiles, 7 recovery rubbing its nose, 8 defeated low seated sheep with spiral eyes and feet forward. Actual transparent alpha, no background, no ground, no external shadow, no glow, no floating extras, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no checkerboard. Clear isolated game animation art, not a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D platformer enemy sprite poses. An original cute UMBRELLA DUCK for a bright fantasy Cloud Kingdom of white cloud bridges, blue sky and gold palaces. A small cream-yellow duck with a golden orange bill and webbed feet, lavender cheek blush, a blue-and-white scalloped umbrella held over its head by one wing on a visible continuous golden curved handle. The umbrella and duck are one connected silhouette; umbrella canopy entirely visible, short sturdy handle joins wing and canopy. A tiny lilac rain cape attached to shoulders. Mischievous rainy-day conductor personality, not scary. RIGHT facing three-quarter profile, hand-painted storybook gouache texture and crisp teal-plum outlines; cream, sky blue, lavender and restrained gold accents. EXACTLY EIGHT whole-body poses of SAME duck in equal FOUR columns x TWO rows grid. Each pose occupies only SIXTY-FIVE percent of its cell, very wide transparent gutters on all sides, no umbrella tip or foot touching any cell/image edge, stable duck body scale. Reading order: 1 calm idle umbrella centered overhead, 2 idle blink, 3 walk A, 4 walk B, 5 warning tilts umbrella and raises free wing to announce rain, 6 attack shakes umbrella overhead with eyes determined, without detached raindrops or action icons, 7 recovery folds free wing and umbrella back overhead, 8 defeated seated duck with spiral eyes and umbrella still safely intact above. Real transparent PNG cutout. No background, no floor, no external shadows, no glow, no floating objects, no labels or text, no grid borders, no checkerboard. Practical clean game sprite sheet.
